The acyl carrier protein (AcpP) of Escherichia Coli is an essential component of fatty acid biosynthesis and is also involved in polyketide biosynthesis, which is a major source of antibiotic compounds.
The main takeaway from our work is that
ACP, which has been studied for decades, has a surprising level of dynamic activity.

we have developed a new method for trapping the dynamic acyl chain on the acyl carrier protein (AcpP) and have used this method to determine the crystal structure of the AcpP–fatty acid dehydratase (FabA) complex.

we have developed a new strategy for studying the dynamics of ACPs in action, which is a major step forward in our efforts to understand the molecular basis of fatty acid biosynthesis and its role in the development of new antibiotics.
